results.title: Charlestown approves gazebo for Ninigret Dog Park
results.description: CHARLESTOWN — After 18 years of advocating for improvements to the Ninigret Dog Park, Parks and Recreation Commission Vice President Tim Quillen finally got one of his longtime goals in front of the Town Council on Monday: a gazebo.

results.title: Protesters counter Trump’s Kennedy Center demolition threat
results.description: WASHINGTON - Protesters formed a human chain on Friday around the Kennedy Center, the Washington arts hub that US President Donald Trump threatened to demolish unless his name is restored to it.

results.title: Himachal Monsoon Weakens, Exit Likely by Sept 25
results.description: The normal withdrawal date is September 25, but the official date will depend on conditions, says meteorologist Sandeep Sharma.
